PowerShell($langs = @\('en','de','fr','es','it'\); $ref=$null; foreach\($l in $langs\){ $j = Get-Content "src/i18n/dictionaries/$l.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $keys = \($j.PSObject.Properties.Name | Sort-Object\) -join ','; $sub = @\(\); foreach\($s in $j.PSObject.Properties.Name\){ $sub += \($j.$s.PSObject.Properties.Name | ForEach-Object { "$s.$_" }\) }; $flat = \($sub | Sort-Object\) -join "`n"; if\($l -eq 'en'\){ $ref=$flat }; $diff = Compare-Object \($ref -split "`n"\) \($flat -split "`n"\); Write-Host "$l : top=[$keys] keycount=$\($sub.Count\) diffFromEn=$\($diff.Count\)" })
